name: Engineering Dynamics
summary: Motion of particles and rigid bodies under forces, using Newton's laws, work-energy and impulse-momentum methods.

topics.name: Particle kinematics: rectilinear and curvilinear motion
Newton's second law for particles; kinetic friction
Linear impulse-momentum and impact (coefficient of restitution)
Angular momentum; systems of particles and variable-mass systems
Planar rigid-body kinematics: rotation, general plane motion, instantaneous centre
Relative motion in rotating frames (Coriolis acceleration)
Work-energy and impulse-momentum for rigid bodies
Introduction to 3D rigid-body kinematics and kinetics
